messages.subject: Suppressing x-axis labels on a given geom_facet
parts:
Hi,

When using theme_tree2 in conjunction with geom_facet (e.g. as in attached image from https://guangchuangyu.github.io/2016/10/facet_plot-a-general-solution-to-associate-data-with-phylogenetic-tree/), is it possible to suppress the x-axis on the 'Tree' panel?

Many thanks in advance!
